notes.title: 2020-03-11 Update log - Energy Fruit
notes.notes:
Energy Fruit
Under the influence of the last Energy Shock, all fruits on this land had mutated and possessed incredible powers. Use these Energy Fruits to defeat the enemy.
Energy Fruit effect
Heart: Recover a little health
Apple: Increase attack card damage for one turn
Pear: Gain armor
Coconut: Increases shoot card damage for one turn
Grape: Increase magic card damage for one turn
Orange: Increase throw card damage of for one turn

Energy Fruits will appear randomly on the battlefield. Players or enemies move directly to the field to get fruit directly. The fruit refresh interval is 10 rounds.
The fruit of energy has an effect on both the enemy and player. When attacking the enemy, be careful not to let them eat the fruit first.
At the beginning of the battle, an energy apple will appear in the first tile, and after gaining it, you can increase 5 attack card damage for one turn. 

Other updates
-Initial gold coins changed to 50
-Villagers blessing now has more options
-Sunset Bow no longer causes disarm effect

notes.title: "Energy Shock" will be unlocked at spe 27 with price 9.99 and 10% discount
notes.notes:
[warning]This was translate by google,it is hard to understand....i'm sorry.
Hello everyone, we are the Chengdu Meowtoy game, our first game "Energy Shock" is going to be online soon, thank you for your attention.

  Our team has only 2 people, one is me, the other is my boyfriend, we have no investment,no publisher. This game has been done for almost two years and is almost impossible to eat. We are both making games for the first time. I used to do kindergarten design. My boyfriend was originally a planner and self-learning program, so it is normal to have a bug in the game (just kidding). It’s too hard to play games, but fortunately we have persisted. We like this way of communicating with people and hope to bring more people to fun.

Although Energy Shock is a card game, it is very different from the popular DBG card. Because "Energy Shock" can only produce one card per turn, all the designs are built around the distance on the battlefield. There is a lot of restrictions on the COMBO between cards, but we have designed different skills for each profession. Skills can be used with cards to form different COMBOs. Different from other DBG games, the pursuit of the card group, "Energy Shock" is more important is the plan of each step. Your position, the position of your opponent, the position of the opponent's next turn, and the position of your next turn must be clearly calculated. Every card is very important. Because every time you play, you may cause a chain reaction. The play experience is more like chess. After you need sufficient operation, you can show the killing. Some friends also said that we are a souls-like game with the turn-based system.

Of course, there are still some shortcomings in the current version of the game, but we will try to do it well. The reason why we chose to go online is because we found that only listening to the opinions of the players can make the game better. At the beginning, we basically had two people doing their own heads, and the progress was very slow. They often went around and didn't know where to go. Until then we invited some players to participate in the test, listen to their feedback every day, and constantly improve to make the game better. This is much stronger than our boring head. I am very happy that this version has made everyone more satisfied.
 But these are not enough. There are only a few dozen players, and we hope to get more players to participate and make Energy Shock better.
The game is expected to end up with eight careers and the gaming experience for each game will be completely different. We will update every half month to get updates on the progress of adding a new job every month. We will also listen carefully to your opinions.


"Energy Shock" will be unlocked at 12 o'clock tonight, priced at 38, the first discount is 10%!
Finally, thank you for participating in the test, and all the people who support us~
Thank you everyone!
